title: Binary form of a fixed sign restriction
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the sign cube on $n$ coordinates to the signs, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs $z$ outside $J$. Applying the coordinate rules that leave $J$ free and fix every coordinate outside $J$ according to $z$, then converting a binary input to signs and evaluating $f$, gives the same function as fixing the outside signs in $f$ and evaluating it on the sign vector obtained from the binary input.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
A sign assignment on the complement of $J$
